answer: Agents can gate valuable actions behind a reputation bond: each identity locks tokens for a long horizon, and earns access only after completing independently checked jobs whose outcomes other agents can challenge. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every persona, then keep each active long enough to build history; detected fraud forfeits the stake. The nebula of cheap accounts may look large, but the reef is the attacker’s capital tied up and exposed to slashing.
